title: phase 3: join a running world, admin-only world control, pause rule
test_cmd: uv run pytest tests/services/test_join_world.py tests/api/test_api_join.py tests/api/test_api_phase0.py tests/api/test_api_auth.py tests/services/test_worlds.py -q
criteria:
Phase 3 part 2: more human players per world. Already present: accounts/sessions (services.accounts), deps.get_account (cookie 'rov_session'), settings.auth_required (default False), errors UNAUTHENTICATED/NO_PLAYER/PAUSE_DISABLED, Player.account_id. EDITING RULE: worlds.py, admin.py, schemas.py and main.py already exist with proofread Thai: use small targeted Edit operations only; new route code goes into the NEW file realm/api/routes/world_join.py.
== realm/services/worlds.py (append + one small Edit) ==
`join_world(s, account_id: int, name: str, tribe: str, real_now: datetime, cfg) -> Player`: world = current_world(s); account must not already own a Player in this world -> GameError INVALID_TARGET 'เข้าร่วมโลกนี้แล้ว'; tribe not in cfg.tribes -> INVALID_TARGET 'ไม่พบเผ่านี้'; name stripped must be 2..20 characters else INVALID_TARGET 'ชื่อผู้เล่นไม่ถูกต้อง'; name already used by a player of the world (case-insensitive) -> INVALID_TARGET 'ชื่อนี้ถูกใช้แล้ว'. Spawn: `ring` = the maximum torus distance from (0, 0) of any existing village of the world, clamped to at most world.size // 2 - 3; candidate tiles = Tile rows of kind 'valley' (oasis_owner_village_id NULL) with no village whose distance from (0,0) is within [ring, ring + 8] and that are at least cfg.world.min_village_distance away from every village (one query for tiles, one for villages, torus distance via realm.core.movement.distance); sort by (x, y), shuffle with random.Random(f'{world.seed}:join:{account_id}') and take the first; if none exist, widen the upper bound by 8 until it exceeds world.size // 2 and finally raise GameError INVALID_TARGET 'ไม่มีที่ว่างสำหรับหมู่บ้านใหม่'. The new Player: is_bot False, account_id, tribe, production_mult 1.0, culture_points 0, cp_updated_at/created_at = game now (worlds.world_now(world, real_now)), protection_until = game now + protection_hours*3600/speed seconds, a capital village (is_capital True, name f'บ้านของ{name}', start resources, layout from its tile, Building rows from slots.initial_buildings, res_updated_at = game now), player.capital_village_id set; flush; return the Player. Also `human_count(s, world_id) -> int` (number of non-bot players) and in `pause()` raise GameError PAUSE_DISABLED 'หยุดเกมไม่ได้เมื่อมีผู้เล่นมากกว่า 1 คน' when human_count > 1 (resume() stays allowed).
== API ==
realm/api/routes/world_join.py (new, router included in main.py with prefix '/api'): POST /world/join body JoinBody {name: str, tribe: str} -> only in auth mode (settings.auth_required True, else GameError INVALID_TARGET 'โหมดบัญชีปิดอยู่'); account = deps.get_account, None -> GameError UNAUTHENTICATED 'กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ'; world must be running (deps.require_running with get_world) ; calls worlds.join_world(s, account.id, body.name, body.tribe, datetime.now(timezone.utc), cfg) and returns the StateView built with the existing helper `build_state` from routes/state.py — but build_state looks up the human player by is_bot False; for the join response return instead {'player': {'id','name','tribe'}, 'village': {'id','name','x','y'}}. Add JoinBody to schemas.py. In routes/admin.py: when settings.auth_required is True the three admin routes (pause, resume, new-world) require get_account to be an admin: no account -> UNAUTHENTICATED 'กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ', not admin -> FORBIDDEN 'ต้องเป็นผู้ดูแลระบบ'; in auth mode new-world links the created human player to the admin account (player.account_id = account.id); with auth_required False the admin routes behave exactly as today. build_state (routes/state.py) is NOT edited: in auth mode GET /state uses deps.get_player so build_state must return the REQUESTING player's data: make build_state accept an optional `player` argument (default None = old lookup) and pass the dependency's player from the state route (small Edit in routes/state.py: add it to the write list if needed).
== Tests == tests/services/test_join_world.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=30, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); accounts via services.accounts.register): join creates a human Player with account_id, tribe, protection_until == t0 + 72 h, a capital village on a valley tile (layout equals the tile layout), 21 Building rows, village name 'บ้านของ<name>', start resources 750 each; the village lies at distance in [ring, ring + 8] where ring = max village distance from (0,0) (compute in the test, clamp as in the spec) and at least 3 from every other village; two accounts joining get different non-overlapping villages; same account twice -> INVALID_TARGET; duplicate name (different case) -> INVALID_TARGET; name 'ก' (1 char) and 21 chars -> INVALID_TARGET; unknown tribe -> INVALID_TARGET; deterministic: the same account id in an identical fresh world gets the same coordinates; human_count: 1 after create_world, 2 after one join; pause() with 2 humans -> GameError PAUSE_DISABLED, with 1 human it works; resume() works with 2 humans. tests/api/test_api_join.py (TestClient + dependency_overrides[get_session] -> rollback `s` fixture; monkeypatch settings.auth_required True; register accounts through POST /api/auth/register): admin (first account) POST /api/admin/new-world -> 200 and the admin owns the human player (GET /api/auth/me shows the player); a second account (not admin) POST /api/admin/pause -> 403 FORBIDDEN; without cookie POST /api/admin/new-world -> 401; second account POST /api/world/join {name:'สอง', tribe:'ironwild'} -> 200 with village coordinates, then GET /api/state with its cookie -> 200 showing its own player and village; the first account's GET /api/state still shows the admin's player; join twice -> 400; join with auth_required False -> 400; admin pause while 2 humans exist -> 400 PAUSE_DISABLED (status 400); the first account can still GET its village and POST build on its own village while the second account gets 403 FORBIDDEN for that village id.

- Thai strings: use ONLY these exact strings (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'เข้าร่วมโลกนี้แล้ว', 'ชื่อผู้เล่นไม่ถูกต้อง', 'ชื่อนี้ถูกใช้แล้ว', 'ไม่มีที่ว่างสำหรับหมู่บ้านใหม่', 'หยุดเกมไม่ได้เมื่อมีผู้เล่นมากกว่า 1 คน', 'โหมดบัญชีปิดอยู่', 'กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ', 'ต้องเป็นผู้ดูแลระบบ', 'ไม่พบเผ่านี้' (already in the file), and the f-string 'บ้านของ{name}'. Do not retype any other Thai in existing files.
- Real columns only in tests. Never commit; never call datetime.now() in services; run only the test_cmd files.
- Existing tests must keep passing (auth_required default False).
